ev.q: Among the 2,030 previous survey respondents, 33% (676) completed the follow-up survey.
39% (265) of respondents reported new or worsening mental health symptoms since the fire
59% (400) reported new or worsening physical health symptoms, among whom 90% were still experiencing these symptoms
among whom 98% were still experiencing these symptoms 1 year after the fire
WCHD and ATSDR emailed a modified survey to all 2,030 previous 2021 survey respondents
This investigation team also conducted a total of 22 semistructured interviews to collect open-ended responses
